title: What is Microbiology?
body: Microbiology is the study of microscopic organisms, including bacteria, viruses, fungi, and protozoa.

title: Bacterial Structure
body: Typical bacterial cells have a cell wall, plasma membrane, cytoplasm, ribosomes, and genetic material. Some have capsules and flagella.

title: Growth Curves
body: Bacterial growth in a closed system often follows four phases: lag, log (exponential), stationary, and death.
